subject: Request: Staggered runway credit extension for Brightroot cohort
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@brightroot.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: accelerator@brightroot.com
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 08:03:21 -0400
Subject: Cohort 6 — runway credits extension request

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're moving three teams from Brightroot Cohort 6 into sustained build and the current trial allocation will run out in ~3 weeks. Can Redwood extend the trial credits for these teams while they complete a second integration milestone? The ask is modest: an additional 60 days of runway split across the three startups (staggered activation as they hit milestones).

Key constraints:
- We need an activation path that doesn't require new legal paperwork for each team (one sponsor-level agreement is ideal).
- Billing must remain on Brightroot's sponsor account (we're covering the spend).
- We need an audit log and a list of enabled workspaces by July 10 for our mentors/ops team.

If there are any promo codes or account-level toggles you can provision, that would speed onboarding. Happy to jump on a quick call today if helpful.

Best,
Olivia Park
Program Director, Brightroot Labs

--
Brightroot Labs | https://brightroot.com
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@brightroot.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cohort 6 — runway credits extension request

Olivia —

Really appreciate the details and congrats on getting three teams into development. We can support a staggered runway extension from Redwood's sponsor program subject to two conditions:

1) One sponsor-level MAA (minimal amendment) that lists the three team workspaces and confirms Brightroot will cover costs.
2) Milestone triggers: we'll enable the next tranche of credits once your mentor ops confirm the integration checkpoint (you can provide a short checklist).

Operationally we can do this two ways: a) issue a one-time promo bundle (single activation code split across workspace IDs) or b) provision credit buckets on your sponsor account and assign workspace-level allocations internally. Option (b) is cleaner for audit logs and per-workspace quotas.

I've looped in Marissa for the sponsor-side MAA and Karthik for the activation steps (he can generate the script to assign buckets to workspace IDs). If you can reply with the three workspace IDs and the preferred activation schedule (dates or milestone names), we'll draft the MAA and the credit plan today.

Attaching a short template MAA and the activation checklist we usually use.

Cheers,
Michael Grant
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments:
- BR-4721-accelerator-sla.pdf (application/pdf)
- credit-activation-steps.txt (text/plain)
From: Olivia Park <olivia@brightroot.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: accelerator@brightroot.com, Samir Gupta <samir.g@brightroot.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:08:44 -0400
Subject: Re: Cohort 6 — runway credits extension request

Michael / team —

Thanks — option (b) works best for us. Workspace IDs below (internal names in parentheses):
- wrk_1007 (NovaGen) — milestone A complete on 2026-07-05
- wrk_1013 (DataWeave) — milestone A complete on 2026-07-12
- wrk_1021 (HelixAI) — milestone A complete on 2026-07-19

Preferred activation: enable initial small bucket (2k token units) immediately for onboarding, then release the primary 20k token tranche when each milestone is confirmed. If you can mark the sponsor account with expiration 2026-09-30 and send the audit list to accelerator@brightroot.com, we'll be set.

Also: Samir will be the operations contact (CC'd) and needs a short runbook for how to request tranche releases (email + HubSpot ticket is ideal).

Olivia

I'll own the sponsor-level MAA and the audit list. Next steps from Redwood:

1) I'll populate the MAA with the three workspace IDs and Brightroot as sponsor; please confirm the legal contact (name + email) to sign the amendment.
2) Karthik, can you prepare the activation script and a one-page runbook for Samir? He needs the HubSpot ticket format and the authoritative email address to request tranche releases.
